about: headers left without a description after the tracer changes that followed the two reconcile passes: unused library entries, and stale image now read from its first whole instruction

B0:B2FC.name: lsrd7
B0:B2FC.desc: the 7-, 6- and 5-bit entries of the logical shift right family: three LSRA / RORB pairs that fall into lsrd4. nothing calls them

B0:B69E.name: scr_10
B0:B69E.desc: add 10 points: D = address of the 3-byte BCD value, then the common tail that goes to ADUSCR. no caller found in any listing

B0:B6A3.name: scr_100
B0:B6A3.desc: add 100 points, as scr_10. no caller found

B0:B6A8.name: scr_1000
B0:B6A8.desc: add 1,000 points, as scr_10. no caller found

B0:B6AD.name: scr_5000
B0:B6AD.desc: add 5,000 points, as scr_10. no caller found

B0:F9D2.desc: self test: start of the walking-bit matrix processor test, reached through the table word at $F7E6

B1:621B.desc: bank 1's copy of the ASRD7 entry of the shift library. nothing calls it

P0:9474.name: s2vw_old_p0
P0:9474.desc: stale image, never run: the tail of a copy of Star Wars' S2VW from an earlier build, read from its first whole instruction. the bytes from $952B on are the same on all four pages

P0:952C.name: s2vw_end_p0
P0:952C.desc: stale image, never run: the last instructions of the S2VW copy, the same on all four pages. they are here so that the slapstic's bitwise addresses $9540-$955F hold something that looks like code - page 3 reads $9540 and $9548 as data to enter that mode

P1:90CF.name: gun_find_last
P1:90CF.desc: X = the last gun record ($4928), falling into gun_find_free. an entry nothing calls

P1:952C.name: s2vw_end_p1
P1:952C.desc: stale image, never run: the last instructions of a copy of Star Wars' S2VW, the same on all four pages - see s2vw_end_p0 on page 0

P2:952C.name: s2vw_end_p2
P2:952C.desc: stale image, never run: the last instructions of a copy of Star Wars' S2VW, the same on all four pages - see s2vw_end_p0 on page 0

P3:93E9.name: s2vw_old_p3
P3:93E9.desc: stale image, never run: a copy of Star Wars' S2VW left from an earlier build, byte for byte the same as page 2's from $9361 to $9560. nothing on page 3 calls it

P3:952C.name: s2vw_end_p3
P3:952C.desc: stale image, never run as code: the last instructions of the S2VW copy, the same on all four pages. lz_hit_probot and lz_hit_space read $9548 and $9540 here as data, which puts the slapstic into its bitwise mode before a maze call - see docs/SLAPSTIC.md

B1:FFC0.name: rom_sum_b1
B1:FFC0.desc: the bank 1 half of the self test's ROM sum. bank 0's rom_sum_2banks sets W_BANK and the 6809 fetches its next instruction here: add the 8K at X, in bank 1, into the sum with end-around carry, then clear W_BANK, which continues in bank 0 at $FFD8. found by running the program (emu_src/tests/coverage.py)

comments.B1:FFD5: back to bank 0: the next instruction is fetched from bank 0 at $FFD8
